comparison.objective: Commission a locked-out shock absorber, versus feed a press blank to a back stop under a minimally raised guard.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate requires fine tool/collar work and iterative response adjustment; record requires one arm to control a gravity guard while the other uses a push stick to feed a blank.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires two safe physical cycles within numeric limits. Record requires guard elevation no greater than 8 cm, blank placement at the back stop, push-stick removal, and controlled guard lowering.
comparison.reason: The press task tests bimanual guarding and remote material feeding, not setting or calibrating a mechanical damper.
